_comment: UNVALIDATED DEFAULTS. These weights and thresholds were chosen by the developers, not fitted to or checked against clinical data. Do not treat the tiers as a screening result.
_scoreUsesQuestionnaire: false (default): the score is a late fusion of the trained emotion models only (face, audio, text, EEG slot). The Gemini mood and PHQ-style values are still computed and shown, but not scored. true: the questionnaire-style score below is used instead.
_valence: Heuristic mapping from a 7-class emotion distribution to a wellbeing value: valence = sum(coef x p), in [-1, 1], then (valence + 1) x 50. It is not a clinical measure.
_tiers_models: Because valence maps neutral to 50, the questionnaire thresholds (65 / 40) would put every neutral-looking person in the middle tier, so the model-fusion score uses lower cut-offs. Also an unvalidated default.
